name: רָפָא
summary: Rapha is the fifth son in the list of Benjamin’s sons. The same name index also includes Raphah, Binea’s son, called Rephaiah in the parallel list.
note: TIPNR links the fifth son to Rosh of Genesis 46:21. Binea’s son has both short and long names. The similarly named giant in 2 Samuel 21 is a distinct person.
